items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the transcript. The mention of 'Ed Allen' is made by the [INTERVIEWER] in a statement about their own musical preferences ('has never appealed to me').

ctx.x: Rosa Henderson or some other thing. What was that Henderson?

Were they issued? Yeah, I think they were issued. I think there were a couple of missions. But anyhow, he went through the marriage ceremony with Mabel. At least he says so, and I'm inclined to believe her, but it may have been a fake. I hate to say it, but I tried to locate the jurisdiction where it happened, but I was unable to. Well, I know who that was. I suppose that was Fussy Mabel then, huh? She was probably Fussy Mabel. Who was that? Ed Monia Henderson. I guess that probably was Ed. Is that right? Let me…
Made Georgia grind and some other two teams. All along, Bo Caddium.
